description: Defines classes and structures related to the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimizer for mobile JIT in PyTorch, including parameter state, options, parameter groups, and the SGD optimizer class.

classes.name: SGDParamState
classes.description: Stores the state of an SGD parameter, including momentum buffer.

classes.name: SGDOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for the SGD optimizer, such as learning rate, momentum, dampening, weight decay, and Nesterov momentum.

classes.name: SGDParamGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of parameters with associated options for the SGD optimizer.

classes.name: SGD
classes.description: Implements the SGD optimizer for mobile JIT in PyTorch, managing parameter groups, optimizer state, and optimization steps.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the SGDParamState or SGDOptions object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for SGDParamState and SGDOptions.

methods.name: has_options
methods.description: Checks if the parameter group has associated options.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns the options associated with the parameter group.

methods.name: set_options
methods.description: Sets the options for the parameter group.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the parameters in the group.

methods.name: add_param_group
methods.description: Adds a parameter group to the optimizer.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs an optimization step, optionally using a loss closure.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros out gradients of all parameters.
